title: CREATIVE FIELD WORK I
rpt_for_credit: This course is repeatable for 8 credits
description: Emphasizes intensive experiential on-site learning in various geographic locations. Provides training to collect or create materials inspired and informed by the interaction with the people and places associated with the area. Explores unique ecosystems and considers history of human interaction with the landscape.
recommendations: Experience in one or more creative disciplines; willingness to adapt to working and spending significant time outdoors; critical thinking, problem solving, and synthesis skills
clssnotes:
A field trip course in Lake County, OR. Meet at Playa Center for Art and Science 9/9-9/14. Lodging, food, and transportation provided.
